title: Development of Open Source Software and Applications

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and master the terminology related to open source software
Understand and explain key concepts related to open source software
Explain various open source software licenses such as GNU, LGPL, MIT, BSD, Apache, QPL, and Artistic
Use MySQL database management system effectively
Understand and use open source application software such as office suites, content management systems, and ERP systems
Use development environment tools like Eclipse and NetBeans effectively
Understand and use version control systems like Git
Manage projects effectively using open source tools
Develop self-learning skills to understand and apply open source software
Work collaboratively in teams to develop and deploy open source applications
Apply critical thinking to solve problems related to open source software development
